title: 'He's a throwback': Fernando Mendoza keeps business focus as NFL Draft waits

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 'He's a throwback': Fernando Mendoza keeps business focus as NFL Draft waits
sources.description: Fernando Mendoza's passion for finance has helped him become a better football player, he says, as the Heisman winner prepares for the 2026 NFL draft.
